children: Nucor reported a higher profit and rising revenue in the third quarter, as its steel mills segment continues to propel the company's earnings.
The steel producer on Monday reported a profit of $1.32 billion, or $5.80 a share, in the quarter ended Oct. 3. That compares with a profit of $607 million, or $2.63 a share,a  year earlier.
Revenue grew to $11.25 billion from $8.52 billion a year prior. Analysts polled by FactSet were expecting $10.84 billion in revenue.

The company's results were headlined by the steel mills segment, where earnings before income taxes and noncontrolling interests more than doubled to $1.79 billion from $793 million a year prior. The raw materials and steel products segments also grew their earnings year over year.

The company said it expects fourth-quarter earnings roughly in line or modestly higher than the third quarter. Earnings in the steel mills and steel products segments are expected to be stable, with an expected slight decrease in earnings from the raw materials segment.
